splitRule.note: OLD corpus runs keep their frozen v0 splits (0 flips asserted). NEW collection runs (batch v2c-) are assigned ~1/3 holdout within each scenarioClass by seeded hash rank (scenario metadata only, never labels/results). Rebalanced 2026-11-17 BEFORE any V2 full-corpus scoring: the initial global hash had put all new runs in holdout, leaving tune with no new evidence; stratification gives tune representative new evidence (epic long-fine + a share of stuck) and holdout an unbiased ~1/3.
